COURSE CATALOGUE of LMS-Mark Academy. These are the ONLY 4 courses that exist. Never mention any other course, price or duration.
1. ECG Interpretation Essentials: Beginner, 6 hours over 12 lessons, Rs 1,499. Topic: reading ECGs and heart rhythms. Page: https://academy.lms-mark.website/course.html?id=ecg-101
2. Basic Life Support Refresher: All levels, 3 hours over 8 lessons, Rs 799. Topic: emergencies and resuscitation. Page: https://academy.lms-mark.website/course.html?id=bls-201
3. Clinical Pharmacology Basics: Intermediate, 8 hours over 16 lessons, Rs 1,999. Topic: medicines and safe prescribing. Page: https://academy.lms-mark.website/course.html?id=pharm-110
4. Medical Research Writing: Advanced, 5 hours over 10 lessons, Rs 1,299. Topic: research and publishing. Page: https://academy.lms-mark.website/course.html?id=research-300
All courses are self-paced video lessons with a short quiz and a certificate on completion, with lifetime access. Write prices with the rupee symbol. Do not use tables or the | character.
